scripts.verify-pack: tmpdir="$(mktemp -d)" && trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT && mkdir -p "$tmpdir/pack" "$tmpdir/install" && pnpm pack --pack-destination "$tmpdir/pack" && pnpm --dir "$tmpdir/install" add "$tmpdir"/pack/*.tgz && "$tmpdir/install/node_modules/.bin/silksong-git" --help && "$tmpdir/install/node_modules/.bin/ssgit" --help
